scripts.build: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 tsc -b && cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vite build
scripts.check:smoke: cross-env NODE_OPTIONS=--max-old-space-size=4096 vite build --ssr scripts/ssr-smoke.tsx --outDir dist-ssm && node scripts/run-smoke.mjs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler pages deploy dist
